motion_pilot_audit.scope: Independently audit matched rigid/deformable holds and replay their resolved body loads.
motion_pilot_audit.limitations: The same geometry/control/contact/mass with rigid versus deformable body motion isolates feedback within the declared short held-initializer protocol. Initial equilibria are solved separately under the same supports/targets, not artificially forced to have identical loads. Linear full-inertia replay separates resolved-load changes from nonlinear constitutive effects. Native recovery, finite-footprint mapping, original approach/angular history, spatial/contact/regularization tails and physical accuracy/cost remain unverified here.

tip_tractions.scope: Audit collision-surface traction quadrature and islands without nodal-load smoothing.
tip_tractions.limitations: Densities divide unsmoothed collision-vertex force resultants by current barycentric lumped areas. Support area is a quadrature diagnostic, not an independently resolved physical contact boundary. All source normal/friction forces and island wrenches remain visible. Total contact moment can retain finite-gap friction torque; its regularization error is separate from pullback conservation. No contact/stress tail or full-arm matching is inferred from aggregate force stability.

summary.invalid_input_reason: These first pilots interpret get_vel(relative=False), measured at the link origin, as COM velocity. Solver completion does not validate that initial physical input. Corrected v2 pilots and full holds transport origin velocity using the captured world COM and angular velocity.

cancelled_dependency_journal.reason: The full FEM producer715175_0 failed naturally at dynamic49 above the unchanged1e-9N body budget. Dependent commands refer to that incomplete run and cannot produce complete80-step audits. These pending downstream jobs are cancelled; live temporal and spatial producers are preserved.

limitations: Captured velocities are independently verified at their correct physical reference points. Initial-velocity-only holds start from solved closures and do not reproduce original approach/lift/support history. Contact stress/patch convergence remains unresolved. First v1 motion pilots contain an explicitly invalid COM interpretation and are retained as diagnostics. Only terminal runs are published; finer and temporal studies remain unverified. The complete original elasticity/model/contact/geometry/history/feedback/accuracy-cost goal remains active. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
